OWNER DECISIONS 2026-10-01 (in chat) on protocol v3.1 (1dd49723):
- D1 approved: v0 gates (TX distance check; GLMsingle install/units/normalization) and the 7-cell pilot on its own beacon-A root, central about 32 core-h, capped at 85. Harness engineering (about 23 person-days) proceeds under separate review. The full-campaign ceiling is set at v1.
- D8a: the full campaign at D>=55 (about 760 core-h) is acceptable, but a campaign of that size must run on the Trillium cluster (Digital Research Alliance of Canada), not on the local machine. v1 must therefore specify a Trillium/Slurm execution plan: JVM on cluster, source/runtime closure binding, deterministic per-dataset jobs, and receipts.
- D8b: tier 2 ('improves'), with tier 1 always reported.
- D2-D7, D5b, D9-D17: recommended defaults accepted as written in §11.
